gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds: 'Operating transfers in (out)' prints '-' in the Water column, '-' in the Sewer column and 5,000 only in the Total column (net operating transfers: Water -, Sewer -, Total 5,000). The Statement of Activities (p2) also prints business-type transfers 5,000 only as a business-type total, and the all-funds budget schedule (p7) prints Transfers in 5,000 for all funds combined. No fund column prints the 5,000, so it cannot be put on a fund line without inventing a fund (the Total column is never used). The report itself does not add up here (Water 45,690 + Sewer 162,788 = 208,478 net income vs Total 213,478). No detail change.
